description.zh:
ACK集群连接器ID。取值来源：

description.en:
The ID of the ACK cluster connector. You can obtain the value from:
- [DescribeAckClusterConnectors](~~DescribeAckClusterConnectors~~): Lists ACK cluster connectors.

description.en: The language in which the health status error reason of the ACK cluster connector is displayed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw describe-ack-cluster-connector --connector-id ac-7c1bad6c3cc84c33baab --lang zh --region cn-hangzhou
